notes: 02: no metadata/title/description/favicon/preview fetching on save. 03: no auto-collection to edit and no description field exists; only manual title editing. 04: url/title/note/tags editable but no description field. 06: duplicate detected but a new bookmark is still created with only a warning; does not converge to editing existing or prevent duplicate. 07: list shows title/address/note/tags but no description or favicon. 10: tags entered via plain comma-separated text input, no autocomplete/datalist. 12: LIKE search covers title/note/url (and tag name) but no description field. 14: no #tag syntax parsing; query is a plain LIKE. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised grouping. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 17-19: no unread flag in schema or UI. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: fixed created_at DESC ordering only; no user-selectable sort key or control. 23: note stored but rendered as escaped plain text, not markdown. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. 26-28: no archive flag, no reversible archive vs delete distinction, no archived list. 29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user settings (font-size in CSS is static, not adjustable).
